title: Manhattan Marvel & Science Family Trip
summary: A 2-day trip in Manhattan for a father and his 12-year-old son who love Marvel, Spider-Man, the New York Knicks, science, and Percy Jackson. The itinerary blends iconic landmarks, interactive museums, and family-friendly stops with halal meals and prayer breaks.
tips: Use the subway for efficient travel between areas. Verify prayer times locally and allow extra time for security at museums.

stops.why: Madame Tussauds New York features a MARVEL exhibit and lifelike superhero figures, perfect for fans of Marvel movies and Spider-Man.
stops.name: Madame Tussauds New York
stops.description: Nine-floor Times Square wax museum featuring life-size celebrity and historic-figure replicas, interactive exhibits, and a MARVEL 4D cinematic experience.

stops.why: Madison Square Garden is the home arena of the New York Knicks, offering tours that highlight the team's history and legacy.
stops.name: Madison Square Garden
stops.description: Historic Manhattan arena hosting professional sports, concerts, and large-scale events, offering premium hospitality, concessions, and guided tours.

stops.why: Dhuhr on the way from Madison Square Garden to Kwik Meal NYC.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Lunch a short walk from Madison Square Garden.
stops.name: Kwik Meal NYC
stops.description: Unpretentious halal street vendor serving lamb over rice, sandwiches, curry and rice platters for inexpensive late-night quick bites.

stops.why: The Morgan Library & Museum houses rare books and manuscripts, appealing to those who enjoy science and literature like Percy Jackson.
stops.name: The Morgan Library & Museum
stops.description: A private library and small museum in Midtown Manhattan housing J. P. Morgan's collection of rare books, manuscripts, drawings, and decorative arts.

stops.why: Asr on the way from The Morgan Library & Museum to SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES offers interactive spy challenges and games, engaging for a child interested in science and technology.
stops.name: SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES
stops.description: Interactive spy-themed museum and experience center offering immersive challenges, skill-testing missions, and a personalized 58-page spy profile.

stops.why: Maghrib on the way from SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES to Adel's Famous Halal Food.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Dinner a short walk from SPYSCAPE & SPYGAMES.
stops.name: Adel's Famous Halal Food
stops.description: Popular Midtown halal food cart serving chicken and lamb gyros, rice plates, falafel, and signature white sauce; open late-night until 4–5 AM.

stops.why: Central Park is a sprawling urban park with lakes, trails, and a zoo, offering open space for a child to explore and play.
stops.name: Central Park
stops.description: Sprawling urban park offering lakes, gardens, trails, recreational facilities, a zoo, carousel, boat rentals, and iconic reservoir views.

stops.why: Central Park Zoo is a family-focused zoo showcasing penguins, sea lions, and primates, great for a young animal enthusiast.
stops.name: Central Park Zoo
stops.description: Small, family-focused zoo in Central Park showcasing penguins, sea lions, primates, and a children's petting zoo, emphasizing conservation and interactive exhibits.

stops.why: Dhuhr on the way from Central Park Zoo to Empire Halal.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Lunch a short walk from Central Park Zoo.
stops.name: Empire Halal
stops.description: Casual halal kebab and gyro spot serving grilled chicken and lamb over rice, mixed salads, samosas, and quick takeout or delivery.

stops.why: Asr on the way from Empire Halal to Bryant Park.
stops.name: Masjid Awliya of Allah
stops.description: 24-hour prayer space tucked inside a Midtown halal-cart garage, accessed via garage stairs and featuring a separate women's room.

stops.why: Bryant Park is a Midtown urban oasis behind the New York Public Library, offering seasonal activities and a relaxing atmosphere.
stops.name: Bryant Park
stops.description: Four-acre Midtown Manhattan urban oasis behind the New York Public Library, offering year-round programming, seasonal ice-skating, food kiosks, free amenities, and public seating.

stops.why: Maghrib on the way from Bryant Park to Museum of Illusions - New York.
stops.name: Masjid Ar-Rahman
stops.description: Midtown Manhattan mosque serving the local Muslim community with daily prayers, religious services, and community outreach in a compact urban setting.

stops.why: Museum of Illusions - New York features interactive optical illusions and mirror mazes, engaging for a child interested in science and perception.
stops.name: Museum of Illusions - New York
stops.description: Interactive museum of optical illusions featuring holograms, kaleidoscopes, mirror mazes, and tilted and reverse rooms for immersive visual trickery.
